translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Magi e weche mag Agur wuod Jake, ma gin weche matut.

content.text: Magi e weche ma Agur wachone Ithiel;
adier owuoyo ne Ithiel niya,
“Aol marumo, yaye Nyasaye,
to pod anyalo wuoyo.
Chutho afuwo ahinya ma ok awinjora bedo dhano;
ok an kod ngʼeyo tiend wach mar dhano.
Ok asepuonjora rieko,
kata ngʼeyo mar Nyasaye, ma en Jal Maler Moloyo, bende aongego.
En ngʼa mosedhi e polo kendo olor piny?
En ngʼa mosechoko yamo moketo ei lwete?
En ngʼa mosechoko pi gi lawe
kata mosepimo giko mar tungʼ piny?
Nyinge to en ngʼa, koso wuode to nyinge ngʼa?
Nyisa ane ka ingʼeyo!
“Wach ka wach moa kuom Nyasaye en adier;
Nyasaye en okumba ne jogo mopondo kuome.
Kik imed gimoro e wachne,
to nono obiro kwedi mi onyis ni in ja-miriambo.
“Gik moko ariyo makwayi; yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
kik itama biro buti kapok atho.
Mi wuond gi miriambo obed mabor koda;
kik imiya chan kata mwandu,
to miya mana chiemba mapile.
Nimar, ka ok kamano, to anyalo bedo gi mwandu mangʼeny mi akwedi
ka awacho ni, ‘Jehova Nyasaye to en ngʼa?’
Kata anyalo bedo jachan mi akwel,
mi ami nying Nyasacha wichkuot.
“Kik iwuo marach kuom jatich ne ngʼat mondike
nono to obiro kwongʼi, mi iyud chandruok.
“Nitie jogo makwongʼo wuonegi
kendo ok gwedh minegi;
jogo ma paro giwegi ni giler
to ok osepwodhgi kuom kethruokgi;
jogo ma wangʼ-gi tek masungore,
manenogi richo;
joma lekegi chalo gi ligangla
kendo nyipongʼ lekegi chalo pelni mabitho,
mar chamo jochan manie piny,
kod joma odhier manie dier ji.
“Chwe nigi nyiri ariyo.
Giywak ni, ‘Miwa! Miwa!’

content: “Nitie gik moko adek ma ok rom ngangʼ! Angʼwen ma ok wach ni, ‘Oromo!’
Gin liel, ich ma ok onywol, lowo ma pi ok rom, kata mach ma ok wach ni, ‘Oromo!’

content.text: “Wangʼ ma jaro wuoro,
ma dagi winjo wach miyo,
ibiro lodho oko kod agak manie holo,
ibiro chamgi gi achudhe.

content: “Nitie gik moko adek mamiya awuoro ahinya, angʼwen ma ok anyal ngʼeyo tiendgi.
Yor ongo e kor polo, yor thuol e kor lwanda, yor yie ei nam mogingore kod yor ngʼama wuowi gi nyako.

content.text: “Ma e yor dhako ma jachode:
Ochiemo to bangʼe oyweyo dhoge,
mi owach ni, ‘Ok asetimo gimoro marach.’

content: “Nitie gik moko adek mateto piny, to kuom gik moko angʼwen piny ok nyal yiego:
misumba modoko ruodh piny, kata ngʼat mofuwo mochiemo moyiengʼ,
moro en dhako ma ok oher to okende eka mogik jatich ma nyako ma omayo dhako mondike dichwo.
“Gik moko angʼwen matindo ni e piny, to kata kamano giriek moloyo.
Biye gin chwech ma tekregi tin, to kata kamano gikano chiembgi e ndalo oro;
aidha bende gin le man-gi teko matin, to giloso gondgi e kind kite,
kata bonyo onge ruodhgi, to ka giringo gidhiyo nyime kaachiel ka gichanore ka ogend lweny.
Kamano olele bende inyalo mako gi lwedo, to iyude kodak e ute ruoth.
“Nitie gik moko adek ma wuodhgi lich ka irango, chutho angʼwen maringo malich miwuoro.
Sibuor, en ratego moloyo kuom le duto, kendo onge gimoro moluoro,
thuon gweno magar ka dwaro gwere gi wadgi, nywok, kod ruoth gi oganda mar lweny moluoro bute.

content.text: “Ka isetimo tim fuwo ma imiyori duongʼ kendi,
kata ka isechano richo,
to um dhogi gi lweti!
Mana kaka puoyo chak kelo mo,
kendo goyo um chwero remo,
e kaka jiwo kecho kelo lweny.”
